entry.description: Entry is the Log entry information

ip.description: IP is the IP address itself

ipVersion.title: IP Version
ipVersion.description: IPVersion is the version of the IP address

country.description: Country is the country of the IP address

region.description: Region is the subdivision/region of the IP address within its country

city.description: City is the city of the IP address

continent.description: Continent is the continent of the IP address

network.description: Network is the network information of the IP address

timezone.description: Timezone is the timezone of the IP address

postalCode.description: PostalCode is the postal code of the IP address

coordinates.description: Coordinates is the approximate geographic location of the IP address

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.title: Geo IP
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.description: GeoIP is the geolocation information of an IP address. It is resolved by the Cluster from the MaxMind MMDB databases that are set in the ClusterConfig and it is only set if geolocation is enabled.

name.description: Name is the city's name (e.g. "New York")

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.City.title: City
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.City.description: City is the city of the IP address

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Continen.title: Continent
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Continen.description: Continent is the continent of the IP address

latitude.description: Latitude is the latitude in degrees

longitude.description: Longitude is the longitude in degrees

accuracyRadius.description: AccuracyRadius is the radius in kilometers within which the IP address is likely to be located

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Coordina.title: Coordinates
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Coordina.description: Coordinates is the approximate geographic location of the IP address

code.description: Code is the ISO 3166-1 country code (e.g. "US")

name.description: Name is the country's name (e.g. "United States")

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Country.title: Country
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Country.description: Country is the country of the IP address

asn.description: ASN is the autonomous system number of the network

isp.description: ISP is the name of the internet service provider

organization.description: Organization is the name of the organization that owns the network

domain.description: Domain is the second-level domain of the network

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Network.title: Network
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Network.description: Network is the network information of the IP address

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Region.title: Region
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Region.description: Region is the subdivision/region of the IP address within its country

id.description: ID is the IANA timezone identifier (e.g. "America/New_York")

offset.description: Offset is the timezone's offset in hours from UTC

octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Timezone.title: Timezone
octelium.api.main.core.v1.GeoIP.Timezone.description: Timezone is the timezone of the IP address

info.description: Info is the detailed information of the authentication operation

setAt.description: SetAt is the timestamp at which the authentication was performed

tokenID.description: TokenID is the ID of the Session's token pair that was issued by this authentication. It is rotated with every re-authentication.

accessTokenDuration.description: AccessTokenDuration is the duration of the issued access token

refreshTokenDuration.description: RefreshTokenDuration is the duration of the issued refresh token. Once the refresh token expires, the Session as a whole is deemed expired.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Authentication
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Authentication is the information of a single authentication operation of the Session

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the method by which the Session was authenticated

external.description: External is the information of an authentication done by an external owner of the Session

identityProvider.description: IdentityProvider is the information of an IdentityProvider-based authentication

credential.description: Credential is the information of a Credential-based authentication

authenticator.description: Authenticator is the information of an Authenticator-based authentication

aal.title: AAL
aal.description: AAL is the authenticator assurance level (AAL) of the authentication as defined by NIST SP 800-63B

downstream.description: Downstream is the information of the client that performed the authentication

geoip.description: GeoIP is the geolocation information of the client that performed the authentication. It is only set if geolocation is enabled in the ClusterConfig.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Info
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Info is the detailed information of the authentication operation

authenticatorRef.description: AuthenticatorRef is the reference of the Authenticator that authenticated the User

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the Authenticator

info.description: Info is the type-specific information of the Authenticator

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Mode is the role that the Authenticator played in the authentication

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Authenticator
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Authenticator is the information of an Authenticator-based authentication (e.g. MFA or a Passkey login)

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Info
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Info is the type-specific information of the Authenticator

userPresent.description: UserPresent means that the User presence check was satisfied

userVerified.description: UserVerified means that the User was verified by the Authenticator (e.g. via a PIN or a biometric)

isHardware.description: IsHardware means that the Authenticator is hardware-backed (e.g. a security key or a platform authenticator)

isSoftware.description: IsSoftware means that the Authenticator is software-based (e.g. a password manager)

isAttestationVerified.description: IsAttestationVerified means that the Authenticator's attestation was verified

isPasskey.description: IsPasskey means that the Authenticator is a Passkey (i.e. it uses a resident/discoverable key credential)

aaguid.description: AAGUID is the Authenticator Attestation GUID that identifies the model of the Authenticator

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: FIDO
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: FIDO is the information of a FIDO/WebAuthn Authenticator

credentialRef.description: CredentialRef is the reference of the Credential that authenticated the User

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the Credential

tokenID.description: TokenID is the ID of the Credential's token that was used for the authentication. It is rotated whenever the Credential is rotated.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Credential
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Credential is the information of a Credential-based authentication

ipAddress.description: IPAddress is the IP address of the client

userAgent.description: UserAgent is the `User-Agent` request header of the client

clientVersion.description: ClientVersion is the version of the Octelium client

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Downstream
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Downstream is the information of the client that performed the authentication

ownerRef.description: OwnerRef is the reference of the external owner of the Session

attrs.description: Attrs is a map of the attributes provided by the external owner

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: External
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: External is the information of an authentication done by an external owner of the Session

identityProviderRef.description: IdentityProviderRef is the reference of the IdentityProvider that authenticated the User

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the IdentityProvider

identifier.description: Identifier is the value that identifies the User account according to the IdentityProvider

picURL.description: PicURL is the URL of the User's picture as provided by the IdentityProvider

email.description: Email is the User's email as provided by the IdentityProvider

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Identity Provider
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: IdentityProvider is the information of an IdentityProvider-based authentication

milliseconds.description: Milliseconds is the duration set in milliseconds

seconds.description: Seconds is the duration set in seconds

minutes.description: Minutes is the duration set in minutes

hours.description: Hours is the duration set in hours

days.description: Days is the duration set in days

weeks.description: Weeks is the duration set in weeks

months.description: Months is the duration set in months

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.title: Duration
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.description: Duration is a length of time that is expressed in a single unit of choice. Exactly one of the units is set (e.g. `seconds: 30`).

id.description: ID is the unique ID for the log entry

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the reference of the actor whose action triggered the log entry (i.e. the User, their Session and Device if available)

targetRef.description: TargetRef is the reference of the target of the action that triggered the log entry (e.g. the Service and its Namespace in the case of a SERVICE log entry)

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.LogMetadata.title: Log Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.LogMetadata.description: LogMetadata is the metadata that is common to every log entry (i.e. the AccessLogs and the ComponentLogs). It is the log-entry counterpart of the Metadata of the Cluster resources.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
